title: docs(investigations): headstock lineage reconciliation (MAINT-DEFER-010), evidence only
intent: Before retiring the orphaned views in packages/client/src/views/cam/headstock/, establish their provenance and what capability would be lost. The owner judged that they may be the refined headstock feature that was in progress, not debris.
behavior_change: None. Adds one investigation document. No source, config, baseline or ledger file is modified. Findings: the four views are the final iterations of a one-day 2026-03-17 claude.ai-generated suite, not duplicates of the archived headstock bundle. Removal PR #308 shows MERGED but was stranded on #306's already-merged branch and never reached main. Of the 11 missing modules, 3 are live at other paths, 3 are archive-only and 5 are lost. The views carry capability (interactive inlay workspace, parametric generator with novelty scoring, import/normalize, customer configurator, and the only UI for the live /headstock-dxf veneer/binding/cost endpoints) that the routed /art-studio/headstock feature lacks.

diff_articulation.what_changed: New evidence document with blob-level provenance, the #308 stranding, a missing-module census, a capability matrix and owner dispositions.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: SPRINTS.md MAINT-DEFER-010 classified the directory as unreachable dead code to delete. This document records that it is the unharvested remainder of a partly integrated feature, which changes the disposition.
